purpose: Second score-blind whole-task recovery after the audited first recovery attempt retained protocol errors.

error_account.selection_rule: A task is selected if and only if its attempt-01 record contains task_error or any arm termination equal to arm_error. Scores and other outcomes are not inspected.

recovery_policy.unit: Entire five-arm task, including a newly sampled shared initial SQL.
recovery_policy.archive: Preserve the attempt-01 aggregate and all six affected task/artifact directories under recovery/attempt-02/original-invalid-run.
recovery_policy.reuse: The unchanged runner validates and reuses all 1,528 unaffected task records.
recovery_policy.attempts: Run one second recovery attempt, then stop and audit. No automatic third attempt is authorized.
recovery_policy.outcome_blinding: Do not use success, SQL content, user turns, or score when deciding which records to replace.
